web-guide-idea-56.audience: Pet owners seeking help from a qualified trainer with everyday behaviour.
web-guide-idea-56.offer: Offer a guided foundation session with a clear, humane training goal. Behaviour involving pain, fear or aggression may need appropriate in-person professional support.
web-guide-idea-56.steps.0: Ask about the pet and a specific routine.
web-guide-idea-56.steps.1: Explain and demonstrate a suitable reward-based exercise.
web-guide-idea-56.steps.2: Watch a short attempt and agree brief practice sessions.
web-guide-idea-56.equipment: A phone on a stand and the trainer-recommended safe space and rewards. Avoid unsafe demonstrations just for the camera.
web-guide-idea-56.returnReason: Review progress and gradually extend the skill. Owners return for useful coaching, not overnight transformation promises.
web-guide-idea-56.promotion: State your actual qualifications and the behaviours you are equipped to discuss.
